TC-18/S09.title: Custom template cannot be saved without a type (both contexts)
TC-18/S09.detail: Local 25acd727 (now judged: TFA-92599 is ready for qa). Same run as TC-21/S13. Hospital and Nursing Home: Save Template with no type keeps the form open with 'Select a note type' and no 'Could not save template'; after Close neither 'QA Template no-type …' nor 'QA SNF Template no-type …' is in the Settings list or templates:list (4/4 for this case).
